criticalFindings: BUG-062: Index Predictor (PredictorHub.jsx:658-659, 1630, 1643, 1658, 1740, 1758, 1785, 1812) prefixes dimensionless NEPSE Index points, Target 1, Target 2, Stop Floor, and 20/50/200 EMAs with 'Rs. ' (e.g., 'NEPSE (Rs. 2655.2)', 'Target 1: Rs. 2690.5'), and hardcodes Index RRR to 1.27:1 at line 551 ((atr * 1.4) / (atr * 1.1) = 1.2727).

BUG-063: PredictorHub.jsx:644 vs 1896-1899 Quantitative Factor Decomposition weights mismatch — internal model uses { technical: 35%, breadth: 25%, macro: 25%, sentiment: 15% } while the UI card displays hardcoded '40% / 20% / 20% / 20%'.
BUG-064: Stock Screener cards (PredictorHub.jsx:3041, 3053) render literal 'null%' for 5D Momentum and a blank empty cell for RSI (14) when 15-session price history is unpopulated in cache.

BUG-065: Contradictory CGT rates on the same Daily Prime Setup card in Stock Screener (PredictorHub.jsx:2497, 2508 show '-7.5% CGT+fees' while line 2615 on the same card states 'SEBON fees + 10% CGT').

BUG-066: Macro & Sentiment sub-tab (PredictorHub.jsx:736-751, 3141-3214) has zero client-side fallback when /api/predict/macro and /api/predict/sentiment are unreachable, hiding the entire NRB Macro Pulse card and showing 'No scraped news sentiment articles currently available'.

BUG-067: NepseAgentDashboard.jsx:685, 688 prefixes 'Unavailable — Only 5 sessions...' with 'Rs. ' ('T1: Rs. Unavailable — Only 5 sessions of history...'), lacks a free-text custom prompt input box (only 4 hardcoded preset pills exist), and omits any SEBON / educational non-advisory risk disclaimer.

BUG-068: nepseAgentTools.js:382 & Master100ProfitWorkstation.tsx:157, 312 make direct browser fetch() calls exposing secret Gemini API key (?key=...) and Telegram Bot Token (/bot<token>/sendMessage) in cleartext URLs.
BUG-069: Master100ProfitWorkstation.tsx:2077, 2081 & ShortTermProfitPlan.jsx:2071 render raw unparsed LaTeX strings ('$\\rightarrow$' and '$EV > 0$') directly as literal text in JSX.

inputs.input: Verify Index Predictor Risk/Reward ratio across changing ATR and circuit-clamped targets
inputs.expected: RRR computed dynamically from (target1 - nepseIdx) / (nepseIdx - stopFloor)
